skill.summary: global-quotes: free stock quotes and news. Use when: user asks for global stock price, quote, ticker symbol, or company news for US (e.g. AAPL), HK (0700.HK)...

latestVersion.changelog: Parallel fetch for multi-symbol (faster); retry on failure (OPENCLAW_QUOTE_RETRIES); optional env OPENCLAW_QUOTE_PARALLEL, MAX_WORKERS; cn_quote/news retry; AkShare single-stock first; unit tests.
